progression_direction.basis: Shortboard in weak conditions is a category mismatch. A wave-appropriate category resolves the issue. [§11.1 P3; basis text mirrors the documented example]

size_direction.basis: Cause is category, not size — baseline sizing formula applies to the new category. [§11.2 P3]

category_direction.basis: too_demanding + category → move toward a more forgiving, wave-appropriate category (fish / hybrid / groveler). [§11.3 P3]

challenge_level.basis: Fit is limiting (mildly wrong), position balanced. [§11.4 P6]

intent_moderation.basis: intent_gap minor — goal kept, cause reframed. [§11.5]
